    About Me

    HIPAA-Certified Medical Virtual Assistant & Registered Nurse

    I’m a HIPAA-certified Medical Virtual Assistant and Registered Nurse with a rare blend of clinical insight and operational precision. I support busy clinics and healthcare professionals with appointment scheduling, patient intake, telehealth coordination, EMR/EHR documentation, insurance verification and billing support, so your front office runs smoothly and your patients feel looked after.

    I’m comfortable working across a wide variety of EMR/EHR systems, for example OpenEMR and DrChrono, and I follow clear checklists and workflows so schedules stay organised, coverage is confirmed before the visit and claims keep moving.

    What if your administrative systems worked as hard as you do? I take care of the details with HIPAA-aware workflows, so you can focus on patient care. Being nurse-trained, I understand clinical terminology and patient flow, which means more precision, and thus more time reclaimed.
